scope: Short wall segment at slow drive and single projected transverse-wave translation on an ordered patch. Example loads and mode shapes only. No physical wall or trapped-wave histories were available for the signed draining-mouth runs.

sympy.command: setsid --fork --wait nohup python3 scripts/s11c_guarded_run.py --pool wall-wave-cut-sympy --memory-gib 2 --log-directory _scratch/s11c/wall_wave_cut_sympy01 -- python3 software/stage1_solver/tools/wall_wave_cut.py
stdout_claim_lines: wall cut current: computed=-T*(-X*sqrt(mu)*s/sqrt(T) + Y*sqrt(mu)*s*cosh(b*sqrt(mu)*s/sqrt(T))/sqrt(T))/sinh(b*sqrt(mu)*s/sqrt(T)); comparison=sqrt(T)*sqrt(mu)*s*(X - Y*cosh(b*sqrt(mu)*s/sqrt(T)))/sinh(b*sqrt(mu)*s/sqrt(T)); difference=0
free slow stored rate per acceleration: computed=b*mu; comparison=b*mu; difference=0
free slow cut flux per acceleration: computed=0; comparison=0; difference=0
reflecting extension slow stored rate per acceleration: computed=b*mu; comparison=b*mu; difference=0
reflecting extension slow cut flux per acceleration: computed=b*mu; comparison=b*mu; difference=0
cycle-averaged packet momentum density: computed=V*f**2*hx**2*rho/2; comparison=V*f**2*hx**2*rho/2; difference=0
cycle-averaged flux before transverse integration: computed=-B*f**2*hx**2*slope/2 + B*f*fz*h*hx/2; comparison=-B*f**2*hx**2*slope/2 + B*f*fz*h*hx/2; difference=0
first-quarter translation fraction, mode 0: computed=4*(-sqrt(1/2 - sqrt(2)/4)*sqrt(sqrt(2)/4 + 1/2)/2 + pi/16)/pi; comparison=-sqrt(2)/(2*pi) + 1/4; difference=0
first-quarter translation fraction, mode 1: computed=4*(-sqrt(1/2 - sqrt(2)/4)*sqrt(sqrt(2)/4 + 1/2)/2 + 3*pi/16)/(3*pi); comparison=-sqrt(2)/(6*pi) + 1/4; difference=0

wolfram.command: setsid --fork --wait nohup python3 scripts/s11c_guarded_run.py --pool wall-wave-cut-wolfram --memory-gib 4 --tasks-max 64 --log-directory _scratch/s11c/wall_wave_cut_wolfram01 -- math -noprompt -script software/stage1_solver/tools/wall_wave_cut.wl
